examples.descEn: Learn to apply binary search on a sorted array, handling the case when the element is absent.
examples.code:
let binary_search arr x =
  let rec loop lo hi =
    if lo > hi then None
    else
      let mid = (lo + hi) / 2 in
      if arr.(mid) = x then Some mid
      else if arr.(mid) < x then loop (mid + 1) hi
      else loop lo (mid - 1)
  in
  loop 0 (Array.length arr - 1)

let () =
  let arr = [|1; 3; 5; 7; 9|] in
  match binary_search arr 5 with
  | Some idx -> Printf.printf "Found at %d\n" idx
  | None -> print_endline "Not found"

  let rec aux acc = function
    | [] -> acc
    | [x] -> acc ^ x
    | x :: rest -> aux (acc ^ x ^ sep) rest
  in
  match lst with
  | [] -> ""
  | _ -> aux "" lst

examples.descEn: Learn to solve the 0/1 knapsack problem using dynamic programming to select optimal items.
examples.code:
let knapsack weights values capacity =
  let n = Array.length weights in
  let dp = Array.make_matrix (n + 1) (capacity + 1) 0 in
  for i = 1 to n do
    for w = 0 to capacity do
      if weights.(i - 1) <= w then
        dp.(i).(w) <- max dp.(i - 1).(w)
                        (dp.(i - 1).(w - weights.(i - 1)) + values.(i - 1))
      else
        dp.(i).(w) <- dp.(i - 1).(w)
    done
  done;
  dp.(n).(capacity)

let () =
  let weights = [|2; 3; 4; 5|] in
  let values = [|3; 4; 5; 6|] in
  let capacity = 5 in
  Printf.printf "Max value: %d\n" (knapsack weights values capacity)

examples.descEn: Learn to multiply two matrices using nested loops.
examples.code:
let multiply a b =
  let n = Array.length a in
  let m = Array.length b.(0) in
  let p = Array.length b in
  let result = Array.make_matrix n m 0 in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    for j = 0 to m - 1 do
      let sum = ref 0 in
      for k = 0 to p - 1 do
        sum := !sum + a.(i).(k) * b.(k).(j)
      done;
      result.(i).(j) <- !sum
    done
  done;
  result

let print_matrix m =
  Array.iter (fun row ->
    Array.iter (fun x -> Printf.printf "%d " x) row;
    print_newline ()) m

let () =
  let a = [| [|1; 2|]; [|3; 4|] |] in
  let b = [| [|5; 6|]; [|7; 8|] |] in
  print_matrix (multiply a b)

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية الفرز بالدمج القائمة على تقسيم المصفوفة ودمجها.
examples.descEn: Learn the merge sort algorithm based on dividing and merging arrays.
examples.code:
let merge_sort arr =
  let rec merge left right =
    match left, right with
    | [], _ -> right
    | _, [] -> left
    | x :: xs, y :: ys ->
        if x <= y then x :: merge xs right
        else y :: merge left ys
  in
  let rec sort lst =
    let n = List.length lst in
    if n <= 1 then lst
    else begin
      let mid = n / 2 in
      let rec split i acc lst =
        if i = 0 then (List.rev acc, lst)
        else match lst with
          | [] -> (List.rev acc, [])
          | x :: xs -> split (i - 1) (x :: acc) xs
      in
      let left, right = split mid [] lst in
      merge (sort left) (sort right)
    end
  in
  let lst = Array.to_list arr in
  let sorted = sort lst in
  Array.of_list sorted

let () =
  let arr = [|38; 27; 43; 3; 9; 82; 10|] in
  let sorted = merge_sort arr in
  Array.iter (fun x -> Printf.printf "%d " x) sorted;
  print_newline ()

let is_perfect n =

    for d = 2 to n / 2 do

    done;
    !sum = n

  let perfects = List.filter is_perfect nums in

let replace_all ~old ~new_ s =
  let parts = String.split_on_char ' ' s in
  let mapped = List.map (fun w -> if w = old then new_ else w) parts in
  String.concat " " mapped

let () =
  let text = "the cat and the dog" in
  let new_text = replace_all ~old:"the" ~new_:"a" text in
  print_endline new_text
